name: Hana Choi
bio:
Hana's journey into motorsport began in her youth, captivated by the roaring engines and precision engineering she witnessed at local rallies. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, she honed her skills in automotive manufacturing before landing a coveted position with Mitsubishi Motorsport. Hana is known for her meticulous approach to fabrication, ensuring every component meets the highest standards of quality and performance.

She is particularly adept at working with composite materials, a skill she developed through years of hands-on experience and continuous learning. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor under pressure and her unwavering commitment to the team's success. Hana's loyalty and dedication make her an invaluable asset, contributing not only technical expertise but also a strong sense of camaraderie within the workshop.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Hana is of average height, with a warm smile that reflects her approachable nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and measurements.
Prefers to listen to classical music while working on intricate projects.
Has a habit of double-checking every weld, even if she's confident in her work.
